Messages.Author: Alan Eisinger
Messages.Body:
Well folks, this here fella named Alan Eisinger, who was big on this
ng a long while back, has been ressurected from his longterm case of
netdeath, and is back to plague the world with his witty comentary
once again.

Hi LSJ, Shane, Curt, Corrupter, and everybody else whose great
conversation I have missed.

Hi Tom (is tom still the netrep?), whose defense of incredibly
assbackward and foolish rulings I have missed.

Hi Ed, whose adds for card sales I actually haven't missed too much.

Anyway, having been out of touch for so long, has anything major
happened in the world of net-Jyhad I should know about?

And while you're at it, are there any Jyhad players in the St. Paul,
MN area?

I am very happy to be back on the net (and in spades! Ethernet
connections to T1's ROCK!)

gnfnrf

>Hi Tom (is tom still the netrep?), whose defense of incredibly

end of July, but has been absent of late.

>Anyway, having been out of touch for so long, has anything major

Sabbat is due out later this month.

My V:tES page has moved to http://Rulemonger.Home.ML.Org
